description: Export a generated monthly schedule as spreadsheet-compatible CSV. Pass the complete project object and either provide the generated schedule as the top-level "schedule" property or put it in the project schedules array. The response contains the CSV text; nothing is saved on the server.

inputSchema.description: The complete Rotase project object. Use the object returned as the "project" field by rotase_examples as a template. Required top-level sections are project, store and employees; availability, preferences, monthlyTargets and schedules may be empty arrays when unused.

name: rotase_export_csv
title: Export an employee schedule as CSV
